arguments.sql:
SELECT d.driverId, d.dob, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS entries, COUNT(DISTINCT q.raceId) AS races, COUNT(q.q3) AS nonnull_q3, SUM(q.q3 GLOB '*:[0-9][0-9].[0-9][0-9][0-9]') AS formatted_times, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN q.q3 NOT GLOB '*:[0-9][0-9].[0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN QUOTE(q.q3) END) AS other_values
FROM drivers AS d LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01' AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url,
    d.dob,
    COUNT(NULLIF(q.q3, '')) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC
LIMIT 1000
